jobs.title: QA Automation Associate
jobs.duties: You design and automate regression tests with developers and business analysts, share clear written test results and plan your work in two-week sprints.
jobs.text:
QA Automation Associate - Northstar Enterprise Services

About the role: Join our QA team testing enterprise business applications.

Requirements:
- B.Tech or B.E. degree from a top-tier institution (IIT/NIT preferred).
- Minimum 3 years of uninterrupted experience in software testing; candidates with gaps in employment will not be considered.
- Hands-on experience with Selenium or Playwright and Python.
- Experience testing REST APIs.
- Exposure to SAP or other enterprise applications.

Who you are: A rockstar tester who thrives in our fast-paced culture and is a strong culture fit.

Apply now with your resume.

jobs.title: QA Automation Associate
jobs.text:
QA Automation Associate - Northstar Enterprise Services

About the role: Design and automate regression tests for enterprise business applications, working closely with developers and business analysts.

What you need (role-essential):
- Demonstrated experience designing and executing test cases and reporting defects.
- Basic Python scripting and willingness to build browser test automation (Selenium or Playwright).
- Basic understanding of REST API testing, or willingness to learn it in the first month.
- Awareness of enterprise applications such as SAP solutions (training provided).

Work mode and location: Hybrid - two office days per week at our Lucknow hub, remote on other days. Core collaboration hours are 11:00 to 16:00 IST.

Career breaks: Candidates with career breaks are encouraged to apply. We evaluate demonstrated, current capability and do not penalise gaps in employment. Returners join our 12-week return-to-work programme with a named mentor.

Interviews and accommodations: Interviews are scheduled with at least 48 hours notice. To request an interview adjustment or a workplace accommodation, contact our accessible recruiting desk at recruiting-access@northstar.example (response within two working days).

Apply with your resume or work samples.

jobs.title: Software Test Analyst (Manual)
jobs.duties: You plan and run manual tests before every release, write clear defect reports and confirm fixes with developers.
jobs.text:
Software Test Analyst (Manual) - Kaveri Product Labs

About the role: Test our retail billing product before every release.

Requirements:
- Age between 22 and 28 years.
- Male candidates preferred as the role needs late evening releases.
- Minimum 2 years of continuous experience in manual testing; no career gaps.
- Good knowledge of test case design and defect tracking tools.
- Basic SQL for checking test data.

Work mode and location: Onsite, five days a week at our Bengaluru office (Koramangala). Working hours 09:30 to 18:30 IST, with late evenings on release days.

Interviews: Walk-in drive only; dates are announced at short notice. No rescheduling.

Apply now with your resume.

jobs.title: Software Test Analyst (Manual)
jobs.text:
Software Test Analyst (Manual) - Kaveri Product Labs

About the role: Test our retail billing product before every release. You plan test cases, run them, log clear defect reports and confirm fixes with developers.

What you need (role-essential):
- 2 years of manual testing experience in total. It does not need to be continuous; career breaks are welcome.
- Test case design and defect tracking (any tool).
- Basic SQL for checking test data, or willingness to learn it in the first month.

Work mode and location: Onsite, five days a week at our Bengaluru office (Koramangala). We offer one month of accommodation if you move to Bengaluru.

Working hours: 09:30 to 18:30 IST. Release evenings are planned a month ahead on a shared rota, and you can swap them.

Career breaks: Candidates returning after a break are encouraged to apply. We assess current skills with a short practical task, not your employment history.

Interviews and accommodations: Interviews are booked at least 48 hours ahead and you can choose another slot. To ask for an interview adjustment or a workplace accommodation, write to careers-access@kaveri.example (reply within two working days).

Apply with your resume or work samples.

- 1 year of experience in IT support, testing or a similar role.
- Clear written and spoken English and Hindi.

- Awareness of SAP applications (we train you on our systems).

Returners: We run a returner programme with a buddy and a phased first month.

Interviews: Two video interviews, booked at least 48 hours ahead with our recruiting contact.

Apply now with your resume.
